༄༅/ /sgrub pa'i thabs kun las btus pa dngos grub rin po che'i 'dod 'jo'i glegs bam dang po (ka)pa'o/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// sgrub pa'i thabs kun las btus pa dngos grub rin po che'i 'dod 'jo'i glegs bam dang po (ka)pa'o//

༄༅// dzayāparimitāyuḥshuklasyasasādhanānudzñāshtsabiharatisma// ༄༅// rgyal ba tshe dpag tu med pa dkar po'i sgrub pa'i thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// bla ma tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di'i rjes gnang thob pa'i gang zag gis/ dben zhing bkra shis pa'i gnas su kha shar du phyogs pas 'jam pa'i stan la skyil krung la sogs pas 'dug ste/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ci nus bya/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig ces pas tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ zhes pas/ gnyis snang gis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa'i stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rang gi sems a dkar po dri ma med pa 'od zer lnga 'phro ba/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las rang nyid bcom ldan 'das tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa shin tu rnam par nges pa'i gzi brjid kyi rgyal po sku mdog ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i steng na 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i rin po che'i bum pa kha rgyan dang bcas pa 'dzin pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ spyan dkyus ring zhing spyan gnyis zim bur gzigs shing zhal 'dzum pa dang ldan pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa/ lha rdzas kyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis mdzes pa/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ sna tshogs pa'i 'od kor mang pos bskor zhing*/ 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro ba/

de'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du a dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas steng phyogs kyis 'jig rten gyi khams yon tan dpag tu med pa nas tshe dpag tu med pa la sangs rgyas byang sems kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang la gnyis su med par thim/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du a dkar po'i mthar mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad kyi gzungs kyis bskor bar bsams la/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal dang sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshe dang bsod nams ye shes thams cad rgyas/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi thugs rje dang byin rlabs rnams tshur 'dus nas rang la thim pas rang gi tshe dang bsod nams ye shes rgyas par bsams la/ gzungs ring sum cu rtsa gnyis sam brgya rtsa la sogs pa mi tshig gis bar ma chod par bzla/ phan yon mdo las gsungs pa rnams la nges shes dang gus pa bskyed/ thun gyi mthar/ rang gi ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkha' byon par bsams la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā pa ri mi tā a yurdzñā na sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ zhes sogs chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod kyis mchod/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa// yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sku tshe dang*// ye shes dpag med shin tu rnam nges pa'i// gzi brjid rgyal po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams dang ye shes thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas par byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ oṃ badzra muḥ zhes pas gshegs su gsol/ rang dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyis dge ba bsngo/ rjes gnang byed na padma 'dab brgyad dkar po'i dbus su tshom bu dkar po bkod/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa dang*/ dkar gtor gnyis bsham/

mchod pa byin rlabs/ bdag bskyed gong bzhin/ tshom bu lhar bskyed/ mchod bstod bya/ gtor ma dang po gzungs ring gi mthar/ a kā ro btags pas phul/ gnyis pa rgyal chen bzhi la cho ga bzhin 'bul/ mdun bskyed la dmigs pa'i bzlas pa bya/ slob mas maṇḍal phul/ rdo rje 'dzin pa dgongs su gsol// zhes sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags bya/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// zhes sogs kyis thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba gdab/ sku bskyed bstim dang rol mo bya/ gsung bzlas lung dang dam bca'/ mdun bskyed rigs 'dra bstims la/ thugs mi rtog pa'i ngang la 'jog pa rnams so sor ngo sprod/ rjes spyi dang 'dra/ tshom bu la mchod bstod gshegs gsol sogs byas la bsngo ba dang bkra shis bya'o// bcom ldan 'chi med dbang po sgrub pa'i thabs// grub chen mi tra dzo ki'i thugs kyi bcud// ma sbas gsal bar bkod pa'i dge ba des// 'gro kun 'chi bdag dgra las rgyal bar shog /ces pa 'di yang shākya'i btsun pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis dran gsor bkod pa'o// 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ ston pa sangs rgyas/ lo ke shwa ra/ grub chen mi tra dzo ki/ paṇa chen buddha shrī/ chag lo dgra bcom/ grum ston dar ma shes rab/ grub chen shes rab dpal/ grub thob legs ldan 'od/ chos rje dpal chen bzang po/ chos rje ye shes dpal bzang*/ rgyal sras blo bzang dpal 'byor/ chag lo rin chen chos rgyal/ 'khon sa skya pa/ des bdag la'o// sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ /grub chen mi tra dzo ki'i bzhed srol tshe dpag med dkar po'i bla brgyud gsol 'debs 'chi med rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru ā yur siddhi pha la hoḥ 'chi med dbang po rgyal ba tshe dpag med// spyan ras gzigs dbang mi tra dzo ki'i zhabs// buddha shrī dar ma dgra bcom la// gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med dngos grub stsol// dar ma shes rab grub thob legs ldan 'od// dpal chen bzang po 'dren mchog dzñā na'i mtshan// blo bzang dpal 'byor rin chen chos rgyal la// gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med dngos grub stsol// 'jam dbyangs sa lo ngor chen ratna'i mtshan// nam mkha' dpal bzang bsod nams lhun grub dang*// bstan 'dzin bzang po mkhyen rab byams pa'i dpal// gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med dngos grub stsol// rmor chen rje dang khyab bdag gnas gsar ba// ngag gi dbang phyug kun dga' blo gros zhabs// tshe dpag med dngos drin chen mai tri'i mtshan// gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med dngos grub stsol// sngon 'gro skyabs sems zung gis rgyud sbyangs te// 'khor 'das chos kun gdod nas dag pa'i ngang*// rang lus snang stong 'chi med dbang po'i skur// gsal bar bsgoms pas bskyed rim mthar phyin shog

/grags stong 'gags med gzungs sngags nā da'i dbyangs// chad med bsgrags shing ma bcos sems kyi gshis// gsal stong 'dzin med ting 'dzin bsgoms pa'i mthus// 'chi med gnyug ma'i go 'phang brnyes gyur cig /ces grub chen mi tra dzo ki'i bzhed srol tshe dpag med dkar po'i bla brgyud gsol 'debs 'chi med rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba 'di ni/ gzim 'og rdo rje 'chang chen po'i bka' 'bangs kyi tha shal gu ṇa pas rang gi nyams len kyi ched du bris pa'o// ༈ /brgyud pa'i kha skong ni// ngag gi dbang phyug kun dga' blo gros zhabs// zhes pa'i mtshams// thams cad mkhyen pa bstan 'dzin phrin las la// gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med dngos grub stsol// smra ba'i nyi ma phrin las yon tan dang*// mkhas shing grub brnyes bstan 'dzin snyan grags zhabs// brgyud srol kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med dngos grub stsol// sngon 'gro sogs dang sbrel lo// zhes pa'ang mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos bris pa dge/ ༈ /grub chen mi tra dzo ki'i lugs kyi tshe dpag med dkar po'i sgrub thabs rgyun khyer bsnyen pa byed tshul rjes gnang gi gsal byed dang bcas pa 'chi med grub pa'i bcud len zhes bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ mtshan snyan 'chi med lha yi dundu bhiḥ// rna bar lhung tsam nyid kyis bde chen sar// dkri ba'i cho ga rab rdzogs tshe mtha' yas// gang dang dbyer med kun mkhyen bla mar 'dud// gnas skabs 'chi med grub pa'i bcud// snying dbus bum par rab 'khyil zhing*// mthar thug bde ldan zhing yangs por// bgrod thabs mchog de'i lag len bri// ces mchod par brjod nas 'dir rgyal ba tshe dpag med dkar po'i sgrub thabs nyams su len par 'dod pas 'di nyid kyi rjes gnang dang sgrub thabs kyi lung legs par nos nas bde ba'i stan la shar du phyogs pas skyil krung gis 'dug ste mdun gyi nam mkhar rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams bzhugs par mos nas/

'chi med dbang po rgyal ba tshe dpag med// sogs kyis brgyud 'debs bya/ de nas skyabs yul gsal btab la/ ngag tu/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes nyer gcig brjod mthar skyabs yul rang la bstim/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rgyal ba tshe dpag tu med pa'i bsgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig ces pas tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ zhes pas gnyis snang gis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa'i stong par bsams la/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rang gi sems a dkar po dri ma med pa 'od zer lnga 'phro ba/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa shin tu rnam par nges pa gzi brjid kyi rgyal po sku mdog ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i steng na 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i rin po che'i bum pa kha rgyan dang bcas pa 'dzin pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs can/

spyan dkyus ring ba'i spyan gnyis zim bur gzigs shing zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan pa mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa/ lha rdzas kyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas mdzes pa/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ sna tshogs pa'i 'od kor mang pos bskor zhing 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro ba/ de'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du aḥdakar po de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ steng phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams yon tan dpag tu med pa nas tshe dpag tu med pa la sangs rgyas dang byang sems kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang la gnyis su med par thim/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du a dkar po'i mthar mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad kyi gzungs kyis bskor ba de las 'od zer 'phros pas sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal dang sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshe dang bsod nams dang ye shes thams cad rgyas par gyur/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi thugs rje dang byin rlabs rnams tshur bsdus rang la thim pas rang gi tshe dang bsod nams dang ye shes rnams rgyas par gyur pa bsams la/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ a pa ri mi tā/ sogs gzungs ring sum cu rtsa gnyis sam brgya rtsa la sogs pa mi tshig gis bar ma chod par bzla/ phan yon mdo nas gsungs pa rnams la nges shes dang gus pa bskyed/ thun gyi mthar/ bdag gi snying ga nas ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par gyur par bsam/ de la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā a pa ri mi ta ā yudzñā na sa pa ri wā rā arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ pā dyaṃ nas/ shabda'i bar la mtshan sngags sbyar bas mchod/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa// yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sku tshe dang*// ye shes dpag med shin tu rnam nges pa'i// gzi brjid rgyal po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod/

bcom ldan 'das bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams dang*/ ye shes thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab/ oṃ badzra muḥ ye shes pa gshegs/ zhes brjod/ rang dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyis/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /tshe dpag med mgon 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /ces sogs kyis dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub tu bsngo bar bya ste/ de dag ni rgyun du nyams su len tshul lo// 'di'i bsnyen pa byed na gnas dben par sgrub khang phyag dar bgyis pa'i nang du rang nyid kha shar ram/ byang du phyogs pa'i mdun sogs 'os pa'i sar gtor sgam la sogs par 'di'i gtor ma phye gtsang ma mar gyis sbrus pa'i zlum po dkar po thebs kyu brtsegs pas sum gnyis tsam du slebs pas bskor ba dang*/ nyer spyod lnga bsham/ thun gsum bzhi gang bde dang*/ gzhan mtshams kyi spang blang thams cad bsnyen pa spyi dang 'dra zhing*/ sha chang sgog btsong sogs ngan zas spangs te/ gtsang spra dang ldan pas gzungs ring 'bum phrag gcig dang*/ kha skong khri phrag gcig stong phrag gcig bcas bzla'o// sbyin sreg byed na thugs rje chen po dang mi 'khrugs pa gang rung gi sbyin sreg la/ lha sngags kha bsgyur te bgyis pas chog go /bsnyen pa'i skabs su gtor ma 'bul tshul ni/ bdag bskyed mjug gi/ oṃ badzra muḥ ye shes pa gshegs/ zhes pa'i rjes su/ rang dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyis gtor ma chab kyis bran te/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du mchod gtor rnams kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlab/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas bde ba can nas mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ

zhes spyan drangs la/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te a pa ri mi tā sogs nas/ ma hā na ya pa ri wā re swā hā/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sogs sbrel ba tshar gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ gong bzhin mchod bstod 'dod don gsol gdab rnams byas la/ yig brgya lan gsum dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis lhag chad kha bskang nongs pa bzod par gsol/ dge ba bsngo zhing bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o// 'di'i rjes gnang byed na stegs bzang por pad dkar 'dab brgyad kyi dbus su tshom bu dkar po gcig bkod/ de'i mdun du zlum gtor dkar po gnyis dang*/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga bsham/ mchod pa byin rlabs spyi ltar byas rjes/ gong bzhin bdag bskyed dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi tshom bu sgrub thabs bzhin lhar bskyed/ ye shes pa spyan drangs la bstim/ gnas gsum byin rlabs bya/ mdun bskyed la mchod bstod dang*/ gtor ma 'bul ba gong bzhin las mgron spyan 'dren gyi tshig mi dgos/ rgyal chen bzhi'i gtor ma tshe chog bzhin phul/ mdun bskyed la dmigs pa'i bzlas pa cung zad bgyis nas/ rjes gnang la maṇḍal dang*/ rdo rje 'dzin pa sogs kyi gsol gdab dang*/ rgyun bshags/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol gdab la/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// lhag pa lha yi ngo bo nyid// ces sogs tshig bcad 'di mdzad kyin 'dug gzhan lung gsum gyi chings brgya rtsa nang bzhin mdzad rjes la/ mchod bstod/ yig brgya/ nongs gsol/ dge ba bsngo zhing bkra shis bya'o// zhes pa 'di yang wa shul rdo khog dgon pa'i grwa rigs 'ga' zhig gis/ tshe dpag med dkar po'i sgrub thabs nag 'gros spel ba bsnyen pa byed tshul dang*/ rjes gnang gi gsal byed kyang yod pa 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes yang yang bskul ba'i ngo ma ldog par/ shākya'i dge slong mai tri karma gu ṇas sug bris su bgyis pa 'dis kyang*/ bdag dang slob ma rnams kyi tshe'i bar chad nye bar zhi zhing*/

mthar thug rgyal ba tshe dpag med pa'i go 'phang thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig /maṅga laṃ// ༈ /bcom ldan 'das tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa dkar po'i rjes su gnang ba'i gsal byed som nyi'i mun 'phrog ces bya ba bzhugs so// gang mtshan bzung bas ring por 'tsho bgyid na// tshul bzhin bsgoms dang bzlas pa'i yon tan mtha'// 'byams klas nges pa'i bla ma tshe dpag med// rjes su gnang ba'i cho ga'i gsal byed 'bri// 'dir grub chen mi tra dzo ki nas brgyud pa'i tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa dkar po'i rjes gnang gi yi ge rje thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub pas mdzad par/ rjes gnang gzhan gyi 'gros ma sbyangs pa'i g.yar ngor ngag 'don gsal byed 'dri ba la/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ stegs kyi khar maṇḍal la/ rdul tshon gyis padma 'dab brgyad dkar po bris pa'i dbus su tshon spungs dkar po'am 'bras sogs kyi tshom bu bkod mthar/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i mchod pas bskor/ mdun nas zlum gtor gnyis bsham/ rang gi mdun du rdo rje dril bu 'thor nas dang*/ slob mar dgos pa'i maṇḍal gyi yo byad bcas bsham/ gnyis pa ni/ mchod pa rnams a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ sogs nas/ oṃ badzra shābda swā hā dang dharmā ra ṇi ta lan gsum brjod pa'i bar gyis byin gyis brlab/ skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed spyi ltar las/ de'i ched du bcom ldan 'das tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa shin tu rnam par nges pa'i gzi brjid kyi rgyal po'i sgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// zhes dang*/ tshad med bzhi bsgom pa nas/ bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa mdun du byon pa la mchod bstod/

gshegs su gsol ba yan chad dkyus bzhin nyams su blang ba ni bdag bskyed do// mdun bskyed ni/ rang dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyis tshom bu bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i zhes pa nas/ thugs kar hūm̐ zhes pa'i bar gyis lhar bskyed/ mchod pa byin rlabs byas la/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a pa ri mi ta ā yurdzñā na re re'i 'gor sbyar ba'i arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā sogs chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod dharmā ra ṇi dang bcas pas mchod la/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa sogs kyis bstod/ gtor ma bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang gzungs ring gi mthar a kā ro btags pa gsum gyis phul/ mchod bstod 'dod don gsol ba bcas bdag bskyed kyi mjug ltar bya/ rgyal chen bzhi'i gtor ma 'bru gsum lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros sogs kyis rgyal chen bzhi spyan drangs la gtor ma 'bul ba/ mchod bstod dang phrin las bcol ba rnams tshe dpag med kyi skabs ltar bya/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ a dkar po'i mthar mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa'i gzungs kyis bskor bar dmigs la gzungs ring ci nus bzlas mthar/ gsol ba btab pa rnams slob dpon gyi bya ba'o// slob ma la bya ba khrus dang phyag byas/ snyim pa me tog dang bcas te 'khod pa la/ slob dpon gyis/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rjes su gnang ba zab mo gsan la don nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i bsam pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan 'tshal/

de la yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas tshad med pa'i thugs rje dang yon tan mnga' bas gdul bya rnams kyi khams dang bsam par 'tshams pa'i chos kyi phung po bsam gyis mi khyab par gsungs pa rnams kyi nang nas rtse mor gyur pa gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa ste/ de la rgyud sde'i dbye bsdu mang du yod kyang*/ saṃ bu ṭa las/ gnyis gnyis 'khyud dang lag bcang dang*// dgod dang lta bas 'khrig pa yi// srin bu'i tshul gyis rgyud bzhir gnas// zhes dang*/ sa skya paṇḍi tas/ mi rigs bzhi dang dus tshod bzhi// nyon mongs sgo nas dbye ba yis// 'di ni rgyud dang mthun par gda'// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bya ba dang*/ spyod pa dang*/ rnal 'byor dang*/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa ste/ rgyud sde bzhi las 'dir rig sngags 'chang gi sde snod thams cad kyi rtsa bar gyur pa bya ba'i rgyud yin/ de la de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs/ padma'i rigs/ rdo rje'i rigs/ nor bu'i rigs/ lngas rtsen gyi rigs/ 'jig rten pa'i rigs te drug las padma'i rigs/ de la'ang rigs kyi gtso bo dang*/ bdag po/ gtsug tor dang*/ yum/ khro bo khro mo/ phyag brnyan pho mo'i rgyud rnams las rigs kyi bdag po'i rgyud/ de la'ang nang gses kyi dbye ba mang du mchis pa las/ 'dir tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i mdo mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa'i gzungs kyi rjes su 'brangs nas/ grub pa'i slob dpon chen po mi tra dzo ki zhes bya ba dgung lo stong phrag gnyis lhag tsam bzhugs par grags pa de nyid kyis bkral ba/ bcom ldan 'das tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa shin tu rnam par nges pa'i gzi brjid kyi rgyal po'i rjes su gnang ba bsgrub pa la/ slob dpon gyis bgyi bar 'os pa rnams grub nas/ khyed rang ngam khyed rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la/ maṇḍal dbul ba/ gsol ba 'debs pa/ rgyud yongs su dag par bya ba/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba gdab pa rnams sngon du 'gro dgos pas/

slob dpon lhag pa'i lha dang tha mi dad snyam pa'i mos gus dang ldan pas rjes su gnang ba zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇḍal phul nas me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ rdo rje 'dzin pa dgongs su gsol// bdag ni 'gro la phan don du// gtso chen khyed la gsol 'debs kyis// ma lus rjes gnang stsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab nas/ rgyud dag pa'i slad du mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i bcom ldan 'das tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa shin tu rnam par nges pa'i gzi brjid kyi rgyal po la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba sprin phung 'thibs pa ltar bzhugs par mos pa byas te/ de rnams kyi spyan sngar bdag gzhan gyis tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun pa bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la nas/ sangs rgyas 'grub par shog ces pas rgyud dag par byas nas/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// lhag pa lha yi ngo bo nyid// dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' drin gyis// bdag la rjes gnang stsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba gdab pa rnams rjes gnang gi sngon 'gro yin/ dngos gzhi la/ thog mar rjes gnang gi gzhi dgod pa'i slad du/ slob dpon gyis oṃ swa bhā wa nas haṃ zhes brjod pas/ khyed rnams kyi phung po khams skye mched thams cad rang bzhin gyis mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid 'od gsal nam mkha' lta bur gyur par mos pa mdzod/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ khyed rang rnams kyi sems a dkar po sogs nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro ba'i skur gyur/

de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du a dkar po dang bcas par gsal btab nas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pa/ mdun bskyed dang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ steng phyogs 'jig rten gyi khams yon tan dpag tu med pa na bzhugs pa'i bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi thugs kar phog de rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul bas/ thugs ka nas thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo yin pa la/ rnam pa bcom ldan 'das tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa shin tu rnam par nges pa'i gzi brjid kyi rgyal po'i sku/ tshad med grangs med bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs te/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la sib kyis thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par mos zhes dang*/ rol mo bya zhing*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badzra ā be sha ya aḥ.aḥ zhes yang yang brjod/ de ltar byas pas bcom ldan 'das kyi sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag par byas/ lus bcom ldan 'das kyi sku dang nus pa mnyam par byin gyis brlabs snyam du mos pa mdzod/ rjes su bzlas pa'i lung gi don du/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon gzungs sngags kyi phreng ba dang bcas pa las sngags phreng gnyis pa mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du byung*/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas thon/ khyed rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i sa bon a yig gi mthar g.yas skor gyis 'khod par mos nas/ me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar nas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ ces dang gzungs ring bzlar gzhug de ltar lan gsum bzlas pas dang pos rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pas dbyer med du byas/ gsum pas brtan par byas par mos te/ slob dpon la me tog 'thor zhing*/ 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gis gzung lags kyi// bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// zhes lan gsum de ltar gsol ba btab nas/

slob dpon gyis kyang me tog phreng ba sngags su byas te/ khyed rang gi spyi bor bzhag cing byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// rdo rje slob ma'i rgyud la bcom ldan 'das tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa shin tu rnam par nges pa'i gzi brjid kyi rgyal po'i gzungs sngags kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa rgyud la 'jug par gyur cig ces brjod cing me tog gtor/ dam bca' ba'i lung gi slad du/ dus da nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob kyi bar du/ bcom ldan 'das yi dam du 'dzin snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ bcom ldan 'das tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa shin tu rnam par nges pa'i gzi brjid kyi rgyal po yi dam gyi lhar gzung bar bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum brjod/ de ltar byas pas bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ ngag gi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag par byas/ ngag bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung dang nus pa mnyam par byin gyis brlabs snyam du mos pa mdzod/ byin gyis brlab pa'i lung gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul te/ thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo bcom ldan 'das tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa shin tu rnam par nges pa'i gzi brjid kyi rgyal po'i sku mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam pa re thugs ka nas rgyangs kyis bye nas byon pa khyed rnams kyi spyi bo nas thim/ thugs ka'i a yig dang dbyer med du gyur par mos pa bya/

de'i ngang las lha sku snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bu la yid cher gyis gtad pas lha sku gdan dang bcas pa 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur/ thugs ka'i sa bon a yig la thim/ a de'ang je chung je phrar gyur te mthar nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar gyur pa la brten nas/ gzung 'dzin gnyis snang gis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis mi dmigs pa'i stong nyid 'od gsal spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba nam mkha' lta bu rgyud la skyes par mos pa byas te cung zad cig mnyam par zhog mdzod/ de ltar byas pas bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ sems kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag par byas/ sems bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs dang nus pa mnyam par byin gyis brlabs snyam du mos pa mdzod/ des rjes gnang gi dngos gzhi grub nas/ de dag gi gnas skabs su thob cing khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa la srung sdom bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs lan gsum/ zhes dam tshig 'dzin par khas blangs nas/ rjes su gnang ba thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇḍal dbul du bcug de ltar maṇḍal 'bul ba ma zad lus longs spyod rnams kyang slob dpon la 'bul/ cha shas nas bzhes la longs spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te sogs lan gsum/ de rnams kyis grub chen mi tra dzo ki'i lugs kyi bcom ldan 'das tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa shin tu rnam par nges pa'i gzi brjid kyi rgyal po'i rjes su gnang ba gsan pa yin pas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzad par zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs kyis dge ba byang chub tu bsngos la slob ma rang gnas su btang ngo*// gsum pa ni/ mchod pa kha gsos nas byin gyis brlab/ gong ltar mchod bstod gsol ba btab nas/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum dang*/

ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bshags/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzod sogs nas/ 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ oṃ badzra muḥzhes pas mtheb srin gyis se gol dang rgyal chen bzhi dang ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la gnyis su med par thim par bsam/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /tshe dpag med mgon 'grub gyur sogs kyis bsngo ba smon lam dang*/ che ba'i che mchog sogs brjod cing me tog gis phyogs kun tu 'thor bas bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o// grub dbang mi tra dzo ki'i thugs mtsho las// legs 'ongs 'chi med mgon po'i rjes gnang rgyun// pakṣu'i spun zlar spros pa'i dge ba yis// 'gro kun tshe mtha' yas pa'i gnas thob shog /ces bcom ldan 'das tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa dkar po'i rjes su gnang ba thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub pas mdzad pa'i ngag 'don gsal byed som nyi'i mun 'phrog ces bya ba 'di ni/ bkra shis chos rdzong gi mgon bla dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab tu 'phral du bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ bha ba tu// ༈ /grub chen mi tra dzo ki'i lugs kyi tshe dpag med dkar po'i sgrub thabs nyung gsal 'chi med zla snang zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bhyaḥ 'dir grub chen mi tra'i lugs kyi tshe dpag med dkar po'i sgom bzlas bya bar 'dod pas/ skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sngon du song nas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma dang*// a las zla steng rang sems a dkar po// de las dri med 'od zer sna lnga 'phros// tshur 'dus yongs gyur rang nyid tshe dpag med// rab dkar zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag steng*// 'chi med bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa bsnams// mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar dar dang rin chen brgyan// zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs// snying dbus zla ba'i steng du a dkar po// de las 'od 'phros steng phyogs 'jig rten khams// yon tan dpag med bkod nas bcom ldan 'das// 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ

/dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥrang la gnyis med thim// rang gi spyi mgrin snying gar oṃ āḥhūm̐// thugs dbus zla steng a yig dkar po'i mthar// gzungs sngags phreng bas bskor las 'od zer 'phros// 'gro kun sgrib sbyangs tshe bsod ye shes bskyed// 'phags mchod mkhyen brtse nus pa'i byin rlabs kun// tshur 'dus rang thim tshe bsod dpal 'byor dang*// ye shes yon tan mtha' dag rgyas par gyur// gzungs ring mtshan so gnyis kyi grangs sam/ brgya rtsa brgyad sogs ci nus bzla/ phan yon mdo nas 'byung ba rnams la nges shes bskyed/ spro na tshe mdo phan yon dran bzhin bton mthar gzungs bzlas pa la 'jug kyang shin tu legs/ thun mthar bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa mdun mkhar byon pa la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a pa ri mi ta ā yurdzñā na sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā nas/ shabda'i bar sbyar bas mchod/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa// yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sku tshe dang*// ye shes dpag med shin tu rnam nges pa// gzi brjid rgyal po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med pa yis// bdag dang mtha' yas sems can thams cad kyi// dus min 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa zhi ba dang*// tshe dang ye shes dngos grub stsal du gsol// zhes brjod cing gsol ba gdab/ oṃ badzra muḥs ye shes pa gshegs/ rang nyid dam tshig sems dpar gsal ba yi// gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan par gyur// dge ba 'di yis bdag sogs sems can kun// 'chi med mgon po'i go 'phang myur thob shog /ces sogs bsngo smon byas te spyod lam la 'jug go /bsnyen pa byed na/ gtsang sbra dang bcas gzungs 'bum phrag gcig kha skong bcas bzla/ snga thun gyi mjug tu bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa mdun mkhar byon pa la/ gtor ma bsang sbyang byin rlabs spyi ltar dang*/ gzungs mthar a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/

mchod bstod 'dod gsol gong ltar dang*/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum mthar/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bshags/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs dang*/ med na gshegs gsol sogs bya'o// zhes pa'ang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyi gsung las snying por dril ba dge legs su gyur cig /sarba dā maṅga laṃ bha ba tu// ༈ /oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ tshe dpag med mgon dkar po'i sgrub pa'i thabs// kun dga'i yon tan 'byor pa'i dpag bsam las// chos sbyin 'dod rgur 'char ba'i legs byas kyis// sa gsum phan bde'i dge mtshan rgyas gyur cig /sarba dā su shrī yo bha ba tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
